description: This file defines the QuickSearchDefaults class, which provides default configurations and methods for setting up quicksearch functionality in SuiteCRM, including generating search parameter arrays for various modules and handling script inclusion.

classes.name: QuickSearchDefaults
classes.description: Class providing default quicksearch configurations and utility methods for SuiteCRM modules.

methods.name: getQuickSearchDefaults
methods.description: Static method to instantiate a QuickSearchDefaults object, optionally using custom class files.

methods.name: setFormName
methods.description: Sets the form name used in quicksearch forms.

methods.name: getQSParent
methods.description: Returns quicksearch parameters for parent module 'Accounts'.

methods.name: getQSAccount
methods.description: Returns quicksearch parameters for the Accounts module with optional address fields.

methods.name: getQSContact
methods.description: Returns quicksearch parameters for the Contacts module, formatted for JSON output.

methods.name: getQSUser
methods.description: Returns quicksearch parameters for the Users module.

methods.name: getQSCampaigns
methods.description: Returns quicksearch parameters for the Campaigns module.

methods.name: loadQSObject
methods.description: Loads quicksearch configuration for a specific module or object, considering relationships.

methods.name: getQSScripts
methods.description: Returns HTML script tags for including quicksearch JavaScript, with backward compatibility support.

methods.name: getQSScriptsNoServer
methods.description: Returns quicksearch scripts without server-side dependencies.

methods.name: getQSScriptsJSONAlreadyDefined
methods.description: Returns quicksearch scripts with JSON already defined, for compatibility.
